body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group COO) on the Q1FY26 call (2025-08-11), prompted: "we maintain that we will look at a mid-teen growth for the full year of FY '26. Quarter 1 was on track. Quarter 2 remains on track." Metric: Consolidated revenue FY26 YoY. Target: ~+15%. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: FY26 revenue +21.4% (screener). Note: in Nov-2025 the Chairman's script softened this to 'double-digit growth for FY26' while the COO kept 'mid-teens'.
